name: codex-claude-subagent
description: Use interactive Claude Code as a role-controlled subagent from Codex via MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Use Claude Code as a subagent from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Codex–Claude Subagent exposes local MCP tools for AI agents to start and control interactive Claude Code sessions. Read-only roles explore and review without edits; the implementer role edits and runs checks only in a required dedicated worktree. Sessions support exact resume, request-level completion through hooks, waiting, long-log paging, listing, and stopping. Model and effort values can be passed through to Claude Code when specified.
